test_dir_with_spaces: test the Boost.Build test_dir function to verify paths containing spaces are handled correctly by actions
test_dir_with_unicode: test the Boost.Build test_dir function to verify unicode characters in directory names are handled correctly
test_dir_with_long_paths: test the Boost.Build test_dir function to verify very long paths exceeding 256 characters are handled correctly
run_boost_build_tester: run the BoostBuild.Tester context manager to write jamroot.jam files and execute the build system with custom environment variables
check_windows_version_compatibility: check the Windows version using sys.getwindowsversion to conditionally skip unicode or long path tests on older builds
